rules.name: HTTP Target Reachability
rules.description: Target URL must be reachable and respond to HTTP requests.
rules.remediation: Verify network connectivity, DNS resolution, and target host availability.

rules.name: HTTP Response Status Code
rules.description: Page must return HTTP 200 OK. 4xx and 5xx errors prevent crawling, indexing, and LLM synthesis.
rules.remediation: Resolve server errors or routing issues to ensure target URL returns HTTP 200 OK.

rules.name: Canonical Tag Consistency
rules.description: Page should declare a self-referencing absolute HTTPS canonical URL to consolidate indexing signals.
rules.remediation: Add <link rel='canonical' href='https://example.com/canonical-path' /> inside <head>.

rules.name: AI Crawler Access & Leak Prevention
rules.description: AI search bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) must be permitted on public routes while private routes (/api/, /admin/) are explicitly disallowed.
rules.remediation: Update robots.txt with dedicated User-agent blocks duplicating private disallows.

rules.name: Page Title Display Preview
rules.description: Page title should be between 30 and 65 characters to avoid SERP snippet truncation.
rules.remediation: Set <title> to 50–60 characters formatted as 'Primary Topic - Key Benefit | Brand'.

rules.name: Meta Description Presence & Length
rules.description: Page should provide a descriptive meta description between 100 and 165 characters.
rules.remediation: Provide <meta name='description' content='...' /> summarizing unique value proposition (120-160 chars).

rules.name: Single Primary Document Outline Heading
rules.description: Page should have exactly one clear primary <h1> heading defining the page topic.
rules.remediation: Ensure exactly one <h1> heading is present and accurately describes the primary entity.

rules.name: Mobile Responsive Viewport
rules.description: Page must define responsive viewport meta tag for mobile indexability.
rules.remediation: Add <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0' />.

rules.name: Core Web Vitals Real-User Field Data
rules.description: Real-user field measurements (LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1).
rules.remediation: Inspect field metrics via Google Search Console CrUX report.

rules.name: Client-Side Rendering (CSR) Empty Shell Invisibility
rules.description: Pages relying on client-side rendering with empty initial HTML shells are invisible to fast AI search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) that do not execute JavaScript.
rules.remediation: Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), or pre-rendering so that semantic HTML and Schema.org are delivered in the initial HTTP wire payload.

rules.name: Indexation Directives (Meta Robots / X-Robots-Tag)
rules.description: Pages intended for public search must not specify noindex directives in meta tags or HTTP headers.
rules.remediation: Remove 'noindex' from meta robots or HTTP X-Robots-Tag response header.

rules.name: Image Accessibility & Alternative Text
rules.description: Informational images must provide descriptive alt text for accessibility and search engines.
rules.remediation: Add descriptive alt='...' for content images or alt='' for decorative graphics.

rules.name: XML Sitemap Syntax & Target Inclusion
rules.description: Public sites must provide a valid XML sitemap with absolute HTTPS URLs and valid lastmod dates.
rules.remediation: Generate and validate sitemap.xml ensuring target URLs are included with valid ISO 8601 lastmod dates.

rules.name: HTML Document Language Attribute
rules.description: The <html> element should declare a valid lang attribute (e.g., lang='en') to guide crawler localization and text-to-speech synthesis.
rules.remediation: Add lang='...' attribute to the root <html> tag.

rules.name: Character Encoding Declaration
rules.description: Page must declare character encoding early in <head> or via HTTP Content-Type header to avoid mojibake and encoding misinterpretation.
rules.remediation: Add <meta charset='utf-8'> as the first child of <head>.

rules.name: Single Title Tag Contract
rules.description: Document must contain at most one <title> element in <head>. Duplicate titles cause non-deterministic SERP snippet generation.
rules.remediation: Remove extra <title> tags, ensuring only one canonical title exists.

rules.name: Single Meta Description Contract
rules.description: Document should contain at most one meta description tag to prevent search engines discarding descriptions due to ambiguity.
rules.remediation: Remove duplicate meta description tags.

rules.name: Time to First Byte (TTFB) Threshold
rules.description: Server wire response time (TTFB) should be under 1500ms to preserve crawl budget and mobile user experience.
rules.remediation: Optimize server backend, enable HTTP caching, or deploy edge CDN.

rules.name: Open Graph & Social Card Metadata
rules.description: Page should provide essential Open Graph tags (og:title, og:image) for rich social media cards and AI multi-modal previews.
rules.remediation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags to <head>.

rules.name: Redirect Chain & Status Integrity
rules.description: Redirect chains should not exceed 2 hops, and permanent relocations should use HTTP 301 rather than 302.
rules.remediation: Eliminate intermediate redirect hops and use permanent 301 redirects for canonical URLs.

rules.name: Canonical Trailing Slash Consistency
rules.description: Canonical URL trailing slash convention should match the requested target URL to avoid redundant redirects or self-canonical mismatch.
rules.remediation: Ensure trailing slash consistency between canonical and requested URL.

rules.name: Canonical Host & Subdomain Consistency
rules.description: Canonical hostname www/non-www convention must strictly match the target host.
rules.remediation: Set canonical URL host to match the site's primary canonical domain (www vs non-www).

rules.name: HTTP Response Compression
rules.description: HTML and text assets should be compressed with Brotli (br), gzip, or zstd to reduce payload size and latency.
rules.remediation: Enable gzip, Brotli, or zstd compression on the web server or CDN.

rules.name: HTTP Cache-Control Header
rules.description: Responses should specify Cache-Control headers to instruct crawlers and proxies on cacheability.
rules.remediation: Configure appropriate Cache-Control headers on static and dynamic assets.

rules.name: Soft 404 Error Detection
rules.description: The server returns HTTP 200 OK for a page that communicates missing content or 404 error text. Crawlers will waste crawl budget indexing empty error pages.
rules.remediation: Return genuine HTTP 404 Not Found or 410 Gone status code for missing resources.

rules.name: XML Sitemap URL Limit
rules.description: A single sitemap file must not contain more than 50,000 URLs per sitemaps.org specification.
rules.remediation: Split large sitemaps into multiple files and reference them via a sitemap index.

rules.name: Semantic Heading Hierarchy
rules.description: Heading levels should follow a structured hierarchical outline without skipping levels and without empty heading tags.
rules.remediation: Structure headings hierarchically without skipping levels (H1 -> H2 -> H3) and remove empty heading tags.

rules.name: Descriptive Link Anchor Text
rules.description: Links must contain descriptive anchor text, an aria-label, or an image with alt text. Empty links provide no context to search engines or screen readers.
rules.remediation: Provide descriptive text or aria-label for all clickable hyperlink elements.

rules.name: Accessible Form Input Labels
rules.description: Interactive form inputs must have associated <label> elements or aria-label attributes for accessibility and assistive agents.
rules.remediation: Associate every input with a <label for='id'> or add aria-label attributes.

rules.name: HTML5 Semantic Landmarks
rules.description: Web documents should utilize semantic HTML5 landmark elements (<main>, <nav>, <header>, <footer>) to demarcate page layout regions.
rules.remediation: Wrap primary page content in <main> and use <nav>, <header>, and <footer> semantic tags.

rules.name: Web Content Prompt Injection Defense
rules.description: Scanned web page content must not contain adversarial jailbreaks or prompt injections targeting AI models.
rules.remediation: Sanitize and isolate untrusted user/web content to prevent LLM prompt manipulation.

rules.name: Indexability Signal Conflict
rules.description: Page exhibits contradictory indexing directives (e.g., sitemap inclusion vs robots.txt Disallow, or self-canonical vs noindex).
rules.remediation: Align robots.txt, meta robots tags, canonical URLs, and sitemap entries into a consistent configuration.
